LLM auditresponse for 99-nephrite-guest-agent.rules:
<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The file is a standard udev rule used to automate the starting of a systemd service when a specific hardware device is detected. 

In this case, it monitors the `virtio-ports` subsystem for a device named `org.qemu.guest_agent.0` (the standard identifier for the QEMU guest agent). When detected, it tags the device for systemd and sets an environment variable `SYSTEMD_WANTS` to trigger the `qemu-guest-agent.service`.

This is standard, expected behavior for a package providing guest agent support in a virtualized environment. It does not perform any unauthorized file operations, network requests, or code execution.
</details>
<evidence></evidence>
<summary>
Standard udev rule for triggering the QEMU guest agent service.
</summary>
</security_assessment>
